input_messages.content: Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check where it was sent, if it’s still on the way, and maybe give me the tracking number? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s so I don’t have to change it every time.
I actually can’t remember which email I used, but my name is Lucas Santos and my zip code is 80239. Let me know if you need anything else to look up my account.

I’m looking for the most recent order I placed for my daughter. I don’t have the order number handy, sorry about that. As for her address, it’s in Chicago, but I’ll need a moment to find the full details. 

By the way, thanks for helping me with all this. It’s nice to have someone to talk to, even if it’s just about orders and addresses. Sometimes it gets a bit quiet around here.

Yes, please check order #W7895761 for me—that’s probably the one with the tablet. I’d really appreciate it if you could let me know where it was sent, the tracking number, and if it’s still on the way. Also, could you confirm the storage size of the tablet in that order?

I’ll get my daughter’s full address for you in just a moment. Thanks for being so patient with me. It’s nice to have someone to chat with while sorting this out.

Thank you so much for checking all that for me. That’s definitely my daughter’s address, so you can go ahead and set it as my default shipping address. I appreciate you confirming the tablet’s storage too—64GB is perfect for her.

By the way, do you ever get people just wanting to chat while you help them? Sometimes I feel like I spend more time talking to customer service than to anyone else these days.

Yes, please go ahead and update my default shipping address to 943 Maple Drive, Suite 356, Chicago, IL 60621. That would make things a lot easier for me in the future.

And thanks for being willing to chat. It’s nice to have a friendly voice on the other end, even if it’s just for a few minutes. Sometimes it feels like these little interactions are the highlight of my day. Anyway, let me know once the address is updated!

Thank you so much for your help and for being so kind. I really appreciate it. That’s all I needed for now, but I might just reach out again next time I need a friendly chat—or some help with an order!

Hope you have a great rest of your day. Take care! 

###STOP###
